concepts.name: Blush Letterpress
concepts.direction: Classic paper-invitation warmth: soft blush and cream ground, deep warm-brown text, generous rounded cards with barely-there shadows. Serif-flavored display moments, floral-adjacent restraint. Aims squarely at the 'trustworthy enough for parents' generation' hint - it reads like a printed invitation the whole family recognizes.
concepts.differentiation: Warmest and most traditional of the three: light warm palette and soft large radii, versus Midnight Garden's dark cool-toned formality and Sunlit Editorial's sharp near-zero radii and high-contrast modern layout. Mood is gentle/romantic where the others are ceremonial or crisp.

tokenOverlay.shadow: feather-soft, low-elevation warm-tinted shadows (0 2px 8px rgba(90,60,50,0.08)); cards float gently, never pop

concepts.name: Midnight Garden
concepts.direction: Evening-ceremony formality: deep green-black ground with ivory text and champagne-gold accents, medium radii, luminous glow-edged surfaces. Celebratory in a candlelit, upscale-venue way - the invitation as a keepsake. Dark-first design that still keeps body text high-contrast for older guests.
concepts.differentiation: The only dark, cool-temperature concept: inverted palette and gold-on-ink luxury versus the light warm ground of Blush Letterpress and the bright airy white of Sunlit Editorial. Density is mid, mood is formal/ceremonial rather than gentle or playful, and shadows are glows instead of drop shadows.

tokenOverlay.shadow: no drop shadows; surfaces separated by 1px gold-tinted hairline borders and a faint inner glow (0 0 0 1px rgba(201,169,106,0.25))

concepts.name: Sunlit Editorial
concepts.direction: Bright modern-magazine energy for couples who want festive over frilly: pure white ground, near-black ink text, one saturated coral primary and marigold accent, squared-off corners and flat color blocks. Information-forward - schedule, map, and RSVP presented as bold, scannable modules that stay crisp on low-end phones.
concepts.differentiation: Sharpest and most contemporary: near-zero radii and flat no-shadow blocks versus the soft rounded warmth of Blush Letterpress and the glowing dark surfaces of Midnight Garden. Highest perceived density and color saturation of the three; celebratory-playful mood where the others are romantic or formal.

tokenOverlay.shadow: flat design - no blur shadows; separation via solid 1.5px ink borders and offset solid-color underlays (2px 2px 0 accent) on interactive elements

The only sub-44 affordance, .map-cta '지도 앱으로 열기', is aria-hidden decoration inside the map preview (the whole 140px map block is the implied target), not a real control.

qualityChecks.expected: Coherent with 'bright modern-magazine, white ground, near-black ink, coral primary + marigold accent, squared corners, flat color blocks, information-forward' and distinct from the blush/serif and dark green-gold sibling directions
qualityChecks.observed: Direction lands convincingly: pure white ground with #1C1B1A ink, coral #E85C4A / marigold #F2B33D used decisively; 2-4px squared radii; a consistent flat 'ink border + 2px offset solid underlay' system with zero blur shadows; uppercase editorial module tags (GREETING, DATE & TIME, HOW TO GET HERE) and boxy date-cell/badge modules read as scannable magazine layout. Visual hierarchy is clear (tag → title → body per module). No serif display, no blush/cream ground, no dark glow surfaces — clearly separable from both other directions. Minor nitpick: hierarchy tops out at 24px display, so the hero is a touch quieter than 'magazine energy' could be, but it stays on-direction.

rationaleSummary: The PRD's competing hints — trustworthy enough for parents' generation, festive over frilly, and a keepsake-quality evening option — map naturally onto three maximally separated brand overlays: warm-light-traditional (Blush Letterpress), dark-formal-luxurious (Midnight Garden), and bright-flat-contemporary (Sunlit Editorial), differing on every overlay axis (palette temperature and value, radius scale, shadow model, mood). The single representative screen is the full invitation scroll at 390x844 because it exercises all nine PRD content blocks — hero through RSVP, transfer deep-links, and share footer — so reviewers judge each direction against the real content density and Korean copy it must carry. Each file pairs that screen with a style tile (palette, type scale, four-state buttons, card) so an approved direction can be applied to the remaining screens without re-deriving tokens.
